screens.name: Global · Government masthead · dashboards · tables

findings.element: Masthead co-branding lockup removed
findings.figma: The masthead right zone carries the SAMAVESH co-branding lockup — the Digital India logo + the SAMAVESH logo — before the user/avatar block.
findings.live: Both logos are omitted portal-wide; only the user name/role/avatar remain on the right. (Present on the login hero, missing on every authenticated inner page.)
findings.fix: Restore the Digital India + SAMAVESH co-branding lockup in the masthead right zone per the design, on every screen.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Masthead identity lockup reduced from 3 lines to 2
findings.figma: 'Government of India / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Department of Social Justice & Empowerment' (Department line in bold navy).
findings.live: Only 'Government of India / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment' — the Department line is dropped and the bold weight moves up a line.
findings.fix: Render the full 3-line identity lockup with the Department line bold, per the design masthead.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: KPI cards lost their metric icon + trend line
findings.figma: Each dashboard KPI card shows a leading metric icon and a delta/trend line ('▲ +14.5% vs last month' or a contextual subtitle).
findings.live: KPI cards render only a label + number — the icon and trend/subtext are dropped, losing the at-a-glance comparison hierarchy.
findings.fix: Restore the KPI card icon and trend/delta subtitle per the design KPI component. Applies to all role dashboards.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Pagination active-page state differs
findings.figma: Active page = outlined (white fill, navy border, navy numeral).
findings.live: Active page = a navy-filled chip with a white numeral.
findings.fix: Match the pagination active-page control to the design's outlined style. Applies to every paginated table.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Data-table header fill inconsistent across the build
findings.figma: Table headers use a light neutral-gray fill (≈#f9fafb, Stroke/50).
findings.live: Dashboard queue tables use a near-neutral header, but the User/Role/Tenant management tables use a light blue header tint (≈#dbeafe).
findings.fix: Standardise all data-table headers to the neutral-gray header token; drop the blue tint on the management tables.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

screens.note: Scope: Global — these elements repeat across the portal; fix once. The board shows a representative frame (Central Admin — Dashboard) — open it via 'Figma frame ↗'; each marker's number matches its TG-GLOBAL id.

screens.name: Global · Application review — validation & documents

findings.element: System Validation omits the Duplicate Check row
findings.figma: System Validation lists three checks — Data Validation, Duplicate Check (with the match + similarity score, e.g. 'Potential match: TG2024-LU-04521 (85% similarity)') and Document Verification.
findings.live: The build shows only Data Validation and Document Verification — the Duplicate Check row is absent, so the duplicate-detection signal never reaches the reviewer. Repeats on every role's application review screen.
findings.fix: Restore the Duplicate Check row in System Validation with its match reference + similarity status. Applies to every role's application review screen.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Documents listed by raw upload filename, not semantic label
findings.figma: Each document is listed by its semantic name — 'Signed Affidavit', 'Aadhaar Card', 'Passport Photo' — with a matching document-type icon.
findings.live: The build lists raw upload filenames ('form1 (2).pdf', 'Screenshot 2026-06-24 221031.pdf', 'tgportal-image.jpg') against a generic file glyph, so a reviewer cannot tell which document is which without opening each one. Repeats on every role's Documents tab.
findings.fix: Label each document by its semantic type with the matching type icon and keep the filename as secondary text. Applies to every role's Documents tab.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Exception Flagged banner never rendered
findings.figma: When the system detects a similar record the screen surfaces an amber 'Exception Flagged: Duplicate' banner above the application, explaining the match.
findings.live: The build never renders the exception banner, so flagged applications look identical to clean ones.
findings.fix: Render the exception banner when the duplicate/exception check trips, per the design.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

screens.note: Scope: Global — these elements repeat across the portal; fix once. The board shows a representative frame (Examining Officer — Application Documents) — open it via 'Figma frame ↗'; each marker's number matches its TG-GLOBAL id.

findings.element: Role-tab switcher removed
findings.figma: The login card leads with a three-way role switcher — Citizen · Admin · Garima Greh — with Citizen active.
findings.live: The citizen build renders no role tabs; the card opens straight into the 'Log In to your account' heading.
findings.fix: Restore the Citizen / Admin / Garima Greh role-tab switcher at the top of the login card, per the design frame.

findings.element: Extra Mobile Number field
findings.figma: The design offers a single Email field under 'or sign in with credentials', then a Send OTP button.
findings.live: The build inserts a second 'Mobile Number' field (with its own 'or' divider) below the Email Id field — absent from the design.
findings.fix: Align to the design's single-field pattern, or update the design frame if the Mobile Number entry is a deliberate addition.

findings.element: Heading casing ('Log In' vs 'Log in')
findings.figma: The heading reads 'Log in to your account' (sentence case).
findings.live: The build renders 'Log In to your account' — 'In' is capitalised.
findings.fix: Match the design's sentence-case heading: 'Log in to your account'.

findings.element: Extra Mobile Number field
findings.figma: The design offers a single Email field, then a Send OTP button.
findings.live: The build adds a second 'Mobile Number' field (with an 'or' divider) below Email — absent from the design.
findings.fix: Align to the design's single Email-field pattern, or update the design frame if Mobile Number entry is a deliberate addition.

screens.name: Citizen — Apply · Step 1 · Basic Identity Details

findings.element: Form grid drops from 3 columns to 2
findings.figma: Self-Perceived Identity and Permanent Address lay out on a 3-column field grid.
findings.live: The build uses a 2-column grid, making the form noticeably taller and pushing the primary action below the fold.
findings.fix: Match the design's 3-column field grid on the identity step.

findings.element: Correspondence-address control changed from a checkbox to Yes/No buttons
findings.figma: A single checkbox reads 'My Current / Correspondence address is the same as my Permanent address.'
findings.live: The build asks 'Is your correspondence address the same as your permanent address?' with Yes/No toggle buttons.
findings.fix: Use the design's single checkbox for the correspondence-address control.

findings.element: Bottom-left action is 'Back'; the design says 'Cancel'
findings.figma: The bottom-left control on the step is 'Cancel'.
findings.live: The build renders 'Back' instead.
findings.fix: Relabel the bottom-left control to 'Cancel' per the design.

findings.element: Active step marker is an outlined ring, not a solid disc
findings.figma: The active step is a solid navy disc with a white numeral.
findings.live: The build renders the active step as an outlined ring, so it reads like an inactive step.
findings.fix: Give the active step the design's solid navy fill + white numeral.

findings.element: Welfare Benefits cards wrap to a second row
findings.figma: All four benefit cards — Scholarships, Skill Training, Garima Greh, Medical Support — sit in a single 4-up row.
findings.live: The build's cards are wider, so only three fit and Medical Support wraps onto a second row.
findings.fix: Match the design's 4-up Welfare Benefits grid so the row doesn't wrap.

findings.element: Sidebar nav has no icons and omits 'Scholarships'
findings.figma: The sidebar lists Dashboard / Certificate/ID / Scholarships / Grievances, each with a leading icon.
findings.live: The build's sidebar has no per-item icons and drops the Scholarships entry (it shows a 'Transgender' scheme dropdown above the list instead).
findings.fix: Restore the per-item sidebar icons and the Scholarships nav entry per the design.

findings.element: 'Other Services' section replaced by the dashboard's Welfare Benefits
findings.figma: The certificate page carries an OTHER SERVICES section with four lifecycle actions — New Transgender Certificate & ID, Revised Certificate (Post-Medical Intervention), Correction or Update Existing Details, and Withdraw a Pending Application.
findings.live: The build renders the dashboard's Welfare Benefits cards here instead, so none of the certificate lifecycle actions are reachable from this page.
findings.fix: Restore the Other Services section (New certificate · Revised certificate · Correction/Update · Withdraw) on the certificate page per the design.

findings.element: Page title and intro paragraph dropped
findings.figma: The page opens with the title 'Transgender Certificate & Identity Card' and an explanatory paragraph about the certificate.
findings.live: The build starts straight at the approval card — no page title or intro copy.
findings.fix: Render the page title and intro paragraph per the design.

findings.element: Action button set differs from the design
findings.figma: The approval card offers 'Download Certificate' and 'Download ID Card'.
findings.live: The build offers 'Download Revised Certificate', 'Download ID Card', 'Gender Revision Request' and 'Collapse'.
findings.fix: Confirm the extra actions are intended and align the primary label with the design.

findings.element: Track / status page is not built — the route lands on the dashboard
findings.figma: A Track page shows the application progress stepper (Submitted → In Scrutiny → Approval → Certificate Generation) with the current step highlighted, plus Withdraw Application, Correction Request and View Full Application actions.
findings.live: The build's track route renders the citizen dashboard instead — the progress stepper and its three actions do not exist anywhere in the build.
findings.fix: Build the track/status page per the design frame, including the progress stepper and the Withdraw / Correction Request / View Full Application actions.

findings.element: Applicant info box uses a neutral tint, not the design's success tint
findings.figma: The applicant confirm box is green-tinted with a green border, reinforcing the approve action.
findings.live: The build renders a neutral grey box, losing the success affordance.
findings.fix: Apply the design's success tint + border to the applicant confirm box.

findings.element: Applicant photograph not rendered in the confirm modal
findings.figma: The modal shows the applicant's photograph with a success check, so the approver can verify identity before committing.
findings.live: The build renders a generic placeholder avatar instead of the applicant's uploaded photo.
findings.fix: Render the applicant's photograph in the approve modal; confirm whether the placeholder is only a test-data artefact.

findings.element: Build adds a 'Remarks (Optional)' field
findings.figma: The approve modal has no remarks input.
findings.live: The build adds a 'Remarks (Optional)' textarea before the actions.
findings.fix: Confirm the remarks field is intended; if so, add it to the design frame.

findings.element: Global filter bar sits above the KPI cards
findings.figma: The design keeps the State / District / Date-range filters inside the Application Queue card.
findings.live: The build floats a global filter bar ABOVE the KPI cards; it is a richer analytics dashboard (6 KPIs + State/District charts) vs the design's 4-KPI exception queue.
findings.fix: Confirm the analytics layout is intended — the extra KPIs/charts are build-only (audit vs the visual language, don't remove).

findings.element: Confirm analytics chart palette uses TG tokens
findings.figma: Charts should use TG tokens — Primary/Source #003366 for bars, Success/Source #2e7d32 for the approval-rate series.
findings.live: Chart series may use raw greens/blues rather than the TG token palette.
findings.fix: Verify the chart palette against the TG tokens; the charts are a build-only section audited vs the visual language.

findings.element: Persistent expanded admin sidebar narrows the content
findings.figma: The design detail page is full-width (sidebar collapsed to a hamburger); the examining-officer / DM detail pages have no sidebar (match the design).
findings.live: The central-admin detail page keeps the admin sidebar expanded, narrowing the content column.
findings.fix: Confirm the central-admin sidebar on detail views is intended; otherwise collapse it to match the design.

findings.element: Detail tab set differs (2 design / 4 build)
findings.figma: The design detail has 2 tabs: Applicant Details, Documents.
findings.live: The build has 4 tabs — it adds Revised Certificate and ID Card.
findings.fix: Build-extra — confirm if intended.
